text:
Aisha: FYI I noticed the TS SDK 2.1.0 beta changed how `X-Route-Priority` is annotated when we do batched retries. Console shows split quota rows for what used to be one tenant.
Tom: oof. screenshots?
Aisha: https://imgur.com/example - you can see tenant xyz shows two small burns instead of one consolidated spike.
Riley: quick theory: the retry batching code sets `X-Route-Priority: high` for primary attempt and `X-Route-Priority: high;retry=1` for retries. Console treats them as separate dimensions.
Nora: that matches the ingestion schema: route-priority is a dimension key, we don't normalize suffixes. Bad interaction.
Tom: is the SDK intentionally appending `retry` tag? Seems fragile. Which file?
Riley: in ts-client/src/routing/retry.ts there's `formatPriorityHeader(attempt)`. it appends `;retry=${attempt}` to preserve ordering for emergency telemetry.
Aisha: we added that to debug latency ordering but forgot console implications. Should be opt-in.
Nora: options: 1) revert SDK behavior; 2) console acceptance-layer normalize `X-Route-Priority` by removing `;retry=\d+` suffix; 3) add SDK feature flag to disable suffixing.
Tom: prefer SDK toggle + short-term console normalization rule. Console change is low-risk if behind a feature flag.
Riley: I can PR a toggle in TS SDK (env var: REDWOOD_ROUTE_RETRY_TAG=false default). Also add a changelog note under Breaking changes section.
Aisha: also add migration note for console: treat `X-Route-Priority` tokens split by `;` and only use first token for bucketing unless `enable_retry_token=true`.
Nora: agree. I'll add a toggle in ingestion config and a unit test to verify existing dashboards unaffected.
ingest-bot: Ingestion toggle `normalize-route-priority-suffix` created by Nora at 2024-06-18T22:05Z.
Tom: once Riley's PR is up please tag `devex/ts-route-priority-toggle` and ping infra to run a smoke test.
Riley: will do — PR + unit + e2e this afternoon.
Aisha: also let's add a short note to the SDK upgrade guide so users who read headers for routing don't get surprised.
Nora: added an action item in Console backlog: CONS-712.
Tom: thanks team. this should reduce noise in tenant quota breakdowns and avoid mistaken shard reassigns.
